title: Three Summers and One Short Jar
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：herb　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 herb 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the gardener ① dried the herb that no guest in the nursery would have described, and he said the drying was the whole of the summer. The ② herb, meaning the plant itself and not the jar, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; a herb, he said, is the only thing in a nursery that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ herb in that nursery had the same short jar beside it, and the ④ herb at the far bench, meaning the leaf they kept for the children to smell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A herb, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the gardener said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the herb was the whole of the matter, meaning the remedy and not the plant. The ⑥ herb, meaning the remedy and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; herb, he said, is either something you dry or the only word that means both a plant and a remedy. He said the remedy is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ herb had become a line in a page, and the page had become an argument about the short jar. The ⑧ herb of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in January, was one nursery and three summers of describing; herb, he said, is either the leaf at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ herb I remember is the plant described in the page, which closed in 1984 and is still described as the quietest in the nursery. A ⑩ herb, my mother said in 1986, is the only plant that improves by being described; every herb, she said, is a remedy that has agreed to look like a plant. She said the remedy was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 药草；草本植物（指苗圃里每一把旁边的那一把）
B. n. 药草；草本植物（指那把草木本身，与罐子相对）
C. 固定搭配：dry the herb 把药草晒干
D. n. 药草；草本植物（指留给孩子们闻的那一把那一把）
E. n. 草药之事（抽象总称，指一处苗圃的药草之事）
F. n. 药草；草本植物（指册页里写到、被记下的的那一把）
G. n. 良方、疗效（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 疗效（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: dried the herb that no guest in the nursery would have described
The herb, meaning the plant itself and not the jar
the herb at the far bench
the herb was the whole of the matter
the herb had become a line in a page
The herb of the whole thing
A herb, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: dry the herb 意为“把药草晒干”，1977 年那位园丁把苗圃里没有一位来客肯描述的一株药草做了一遍。
herb 意为“药草；草本植物”，指那把草木本身而不是罐子，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
herb 意为“药草；草本植物”，指苗圃里每一把旁边的那一把，每一把旁边都有同一个小小的短罐。
herb 意为“药草；草本植物”，指最远那条长凳留给孩子们闻的那一把那一把，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
herb 意为“良方、疗效”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张良方就是那件事的全部。
herb 意为“疗效”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那把草木，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
herb 意为“药草；草本植物”，指册页里写到、被记下的的那一把，到 1982 年这一把成了册页里的一行。
herb 意为“草药之事”，园丁一月写道，整件事的药草之事是一处苗圃和三个夏天的描述。
herb 意为“药草；草本植物”，我记得的是册页里描述过的那一把，1984 年采完了，至今仍被说成苗圃里最安静的一把。
herb 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，药草是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的草木。
